title: Moc Chau food: 5 dishes
region: Mộc Châu, Sơn La, Việt Nam

scenes.caption: MOC CHAU EATS
scenes.label: 5 DISHES
scenes.narration: What to eat in Moc Chau? Here are the five northwest dishes people talk about most, with how to eat them and places rated four and a half stars or more.

scenes.caption: Salmon & sturgeon
scenes.narration: Dish number one, salmon and sturgeon, the plateau's newer specialty, with restaurants clustered in Chieng Di and Vuon Dao. It's served as a raw salad, grilled, as crispy skin, in hotpot or porridge. To eat, order a five or six dish set for the group and book ahead on weekends. Try Phuong Nhi, Xuan Bac in Chieng Di or Ca Hoi twenty-six.

scenes.caption: Grilled stream fish
scenes.narration: Dish number two, grilled stream fish, which the Thai people call pa pinh top, folded grilled fish. It's marinated in mac khen pepper, lemongrass and ginger, folded into a bamboo clamp and grilled over charcoal. To eat, have it with sticky rice and wild greens, and ask ahead, it isn't always on. Try A Pao, Com Thai Son La or Hieu Thoa.

scenes.caption: Smoked buffalo
scenes.narration: Dish number three, smoked buffalo, a specialty of the Black Thai people. The meat is rubbed with chili, ginger and mac khen pepper, then hung above the hearth and smoked for days. To eat, tear it into strips and dip it in fiery cham cheo; buy gifts from trusted shops. Try A Pao, Ban Moc Quan or Hieu Thoa.

scenes.caption: Five-colour rice
scenes.narration: Dish number four, five-colour sticky rice, a tradition of the Thai people. Upland sticky rice is dyed with leaves and steamed together in one pot. To eat, dip it in sesame salt or crushed peanuts, with chicken or grilled fish. Try Phuong Nhi, Com Thai Son La or Nha Hang Viet in Van Ho.

scenes.caption: Night-market skewers
scenes.narration: Dish number five, night-market skewers. When evening falls, the town centre fills with grills. Marinated meat goes onto skewers over charcoal. To eat, stroll the market skewer in hand, and if it's too cold, sit down at a grill house. Try Nguyet Anh, TuSa or Leo Xeo.
